name: How can I prevent laundry drain clogs?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent laundry drain clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent laundry drain clogs, regularly clean your washing machine's lint trap and avoid overloading the machine, which can push excess lint into the drain. Using appropriate amounts of detergent and fabric softener can also reduce residue buildup. For an added layer of protection, consider using a mesh lint screen over the drain hose discharge point to catch any lint that escapes the washer. Regular maintenance can significantly extend the life of your plumbing and prevent inconvenient backups.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by cleaning your washer's lint trap, avoiding overloading, using less detergent, and adding a mesh lint screen.
